verdict.rationale: CockroachDB Cloud provides Request Unit consumption tracking, a monthly cost estimate, and resource-usage diagnostics pages (docs-9, docs-11, docs-22, docs-29), giving founders visibility into spend before it grows, but there is no evidence of an actual configurable spend cap or automated usage alert/notification feature that stops or warns about runaway queries before billing occurs. missing for 10: explicit spend-cap/budget-limit configuration, proactive alerting/notification mechanism (email/webhook) tied to usage thresholds, and confirmation that caps actually throttle/stop billing rather than just reporting after the fact.
